explanation:
`t % 2` splits every warp in half. `t / 32` is the warp's index, the same for all its lanes, so a branch on it is
uniform. `blockIdx.x` is the same for the whole block. `t < 100` splits only warp 3 (threads 96–127); the other warps
are uniform, so only one warp in eight pays. Data-dependent branches on random data diverge in nearly every warp.
